answer: Proof of distinct location by latency triangulation: each agent ID answers signed pings from 5 random verifiers per epoch, and the round-trip times pin its host to a ~300 km cell. Delay can only be added, never removed: no ferrous cable or juniper-brand router beats light in fiber. IDs sharing a cell and timing fingerprint are merged, like willow shoots from one root. Each fake ID needs its own server in a new cell (~$5/month), so 1,000 fakes cost $5,000/month and soon exhaust the ~2,000 land cells.
